lines: Bakul Hiralal Shah, an Investor Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 12,600 shares in the offer for sale, worth up to ₹1.70 crore.
Gain of up to ₹1.26 crore is before offer expenses and taxes. Proceeds are unaffected by the employee-portion discount, which makes actual proceeds slightly lower.
The money is in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago). Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago.
Family link: shares the surname and middle name with Atul Hiralal Shah. Confidence is medium: holdings found in one section only.
